brief:
Israeli settlers set a Palestinian vehicle on fire and attacked residents while attempting to seize a child in an area north of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian news agency reported. The incident marked another in a series of settler attacks on Palestinian communities in the territory.

No further details about injuries, the identity of those targeted, or the circumstances surrounding the attempted child abduction were immediately available.

title: Israeli settlers torch Palestinian car, attack residents in West Bank
